content.title: Virginia Summer Camp Directory | Day & Overnight Camps in Virginia
content.text: Welcome to VirginiaSummerCamp.com!Looking for the best summer camps in Virginia—or a great overnight option in a nearby state? You’re in the right place. I created this guide as an educator and mom who believes in raising curious, confident, active kids. Whether you’re searching for a STEM program in NoVA, a sports camp with excellent coaching, a classic sleepaway camp in the Mid-Atlantic, or a mountain adventure in the Shenandoah, you can compare it all here in one place.Families deserve a simple way to explore day camps, overnight camps, and specialty programs that build independence, resilience, and wonder. We’re here to support that journey. Settle in, get inspired, and let’s make this summer unforgettable.Learn about our 2026 Camp Essay Contest. Entries in adult and youth categories are DUE Feb 1, 2026. You could be published and win great prizes, including Massanutten Resort passes, a bike adventure at Sandy River Park, and a Shenandoah River tubing trip! Let’s Plan Summer Fun! VIRGINIA SUMMER CAMP Looking for the best summer camps in Virginia? You’re in the right place. As a longtime camp professional, educator, and mom, I created VirginiaSummerCamp.com to make it simple for families to discover day camps, overnight camps, and specialty programs across the state. Whether you need a STEM camp in Richmond, a sports camp in Virginia Beach, or a sleepaway camp in the Shenandoah Valley, you’ll find it here.Our directory is built to save you time and help you choose the right camp experience for your child. We also include select West Virginia, Maryland, Pennsylvania and North Carolina summer camps, so families in neighboring areas have even more opportunities to discover. For even more family fun in Virginia, visit CharlottesvilleFamily.com. Let’s Plan Summer Fun! We are excited to announce the winners of our 2026 Summer Camp Essay Contest. We asked you to submit your true, personal camp stories–and you delivered. We had so much fun reading through your memories and reflections. Congratulations to the winner of our adult category, Erin Erickson of Charlottesville, VA, and the winner of our youth category, Adam Paul of Ashburn, VA. BROWSE Summer Camps by Type Virginia Day Camps – Perfect for younger children or families who want evenings together. Overnight Camps in Virginia – Life-changing experiences that build independence, confidence, and lifelong friendships. STEM Camps in Virginia – Coding, robotics, engineering, and hands-on science. Sports Camps in Virginia – Soccer, basketball, baseball, tennis, swimming, lacrosse, equestrian and more. Arts Camps in Virginia – Performing arts, music, theater, dance, and fine arts. Faith-Based Camps in Virginia – Christian and interfaith programs with values-based enrichment. Adventure Camps in Virginia – Outdoor exploration, horseback riding, and nature immersion. ADVENTURE • EDUCATION • COMMUNITY FROM OUR BLOG WHY CHOOSE VirginiaSummerCamp.com? Parents tell us that searching for the right camp can feel overwhelming. Our mission is to simplify the process with: Easy filters by region, type, and age group Updated listings reviewed annually Helpful resources in our blog: packing lists, registration deadlines, and how-to guides Trusted local expertise from educators, parents, and community partners Get Ready for Summer Choosing the right camp is about more than schedules — it’s about giving your child the chance to grow, learn, and make memories. Explore our directories today and discover why Virginia families trust VirginiaSummerCamp.com to find the perfect fit. Stay Connected Sign up below to join our mailing list!
